gitCommit.subject: fix(TSK-5780): limit admin functions to the caller's data scope (#1886)
gitCommit.body:
fix(TSK-5780): limit admin functions to the caller's data scope (#1886)

* fix(TSK-5780): limit admin functions to the caller's data scope

External partner roles (organization-admin, business-admin, coin-pool-admin,
ambassador) hold codes such as write-userManagement and write-token-history,
but several admin functions checked only the code, not whose data it was.

- data/admin/admin-scope.ts: single source for what an admin may see.
  Roles and organization are read from the DB (the session never set
  organizationId). getAdminUsers now uses buildAdminUserVisibilityWhere;
  the list result is unchanged for single-role admins.
- banUser / unbanUser, verify / resend verification email, reset password:
  target must be visible to the caller in /admin/users; the ban reviewer
  is always the caller (no longer sent by the browser).
- Paid-user statistics (token usage top users / stats, subscription cycle
  stats) require write-purchase only.
- Admin image generations, download-zip and summary: explicit userIds are
  intersected with the caller's scope (organization + redeemers of
  invitation codes the caller may view); never widen to everyone.
- images/src, videos/src, video-details: scope from the DB instead of the
  missing session organizationId.
- By-id updates (image / artwork NSFW, image / video status, webtoon
  visibility, retry, delete video request) check the same scope first.
- Artwork and webtoon reports follow the list scope; canvas scope fails
  closed for an organization-admin without an organization.
- Docs: architecture rule and product doc section; tests for each case.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* test(TSK-5780): per-role admin scope matrix for organization, business, coin-pool, ambassador and planner roles

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(TSK-5780): validate contest send-tokens input and record the issuing admin

- Zod-check the body: 1-1000 rows, positive whole amounts up to 100,000
  per user; reject the whole batch on any invalid row (400).
- Require a logged-in caller (401) and pass actorUserId to creditToken so
  TokenTransaction shows who issued the prize. No schema change: the
  actorUserId column already exists.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(TSK-5780): warn on low coin pool balance when creating codes; whole-number manual token amounts

- createInvitationCodesBatch: for pool codes, compare the pool balance with
  tokenAmount x maxUses x codes. If short, return
  COIN_POOL_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE with poolBalance/requiredTokens. The
  dialog shows the warning and a "create anyway" button that resubmits with
  confirmInsufficientBalance. Redemption still fails when the pool runs out.
  Official codes are not checked. The balance is only read after the caller
  is allowed to use the pool.
- Manual token record: amount must be an integer (action schema for
  credit/debit/transfer, and the dialog form with its own error message in
  four locales).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(TSK-5780): reserve open codes when checking coin pool balance; clearer warning

- Pool balance check now subtracts what the pool's other redeemable codes
  (active, not expired, not used up) can still pay out:
  tokenAmount x (maxUses - currentUses). The new codes must fit in what is left.
- Pure math in lib/admin/invitation-code-pool-coverage.ts with unit tests;
  open codes are read by data/admin/invitation-code getOpenCoinPoolCodes.
- Warning lists pool balance, reserved by other codes, available and
  required, explains the calculation, and suggests deactivating unused
  codes or contacting sales (gazaichan@gazai.io). Four locales.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(TSK-5780): low pool balance hint only points to sales

Drop the "deactivate unused codes" suggestion; ask admins to contact sales
to buy more tokens. Four locales.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(TSK-5780): shorter low pool balance warning that scrolls into view

- Three lines: shortfall headline (available vs required), the
  balance − reserved breakdown, and the contact-sales hint. Four locales.
- The dialog scrolls when content is tall; bring the warning and the
  "create anyway" button into view when the warning appears.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* style(TSK-5780): show invitation code status with StatusBadge

Available codes get the active badge; expired, used up and disabled get the
inactive badge with their own label.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* style(TSK-5780): show invitation code detail status with StatusBadge

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(TSK-5780): validate invitation code image-generations query

Zod-check cursor, pageSize (1-100, default 24), searchPrompt, baseModelIds
and start/end dates; invalid values return 400 instead of an unbounded
query or a 500. Validation runs after the login and code visibility checks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
